item.title: Beekman Social - Account Manager at Beekman Social
item.description: OPPORTUNITY: ACCOUNT MANAGER Minimum 3 years of experience working in account management within a social, creative, or integrated agency Freelance role, with possibilities of it becoming a Full Time position BKMN is a fully remote agency Hourly rate / compensation based on experience Beekman Social is currently seeking a sharp, client-facing Account Manager to support key accounts on a freelance basis. This role will be instrumental in owning day-to-day client relationships and ensuring seamless execution across social-first creative work.

item.title: Web Design and Marketing Partners at B12
item.description: The Role: We’re an AI Website Builder that allows businesses to create beautiful and functional websites. B12 is launching a new expert marketplace that connects top-tier web designers, freelancers, and agencies with B12 users who need help creating and refining their websites and digital marketing. If you love crafting and growing websites and are looking for an exciting new challenge, we’d love for you to apply! As an expert in our partner ecosystem, you’ll have the opportunity to work directly with clients who use B12. You can expect to receive projects and referrals through our platform.
